main_body: A large low piece with a wide pale-green top surface (rows 2-10) and a brown front body below it (rows 14-40). A dark scalloped shadow band sits between the two, and a grey base strip runs along the bottom.
top_band: pale green #96a262, rows 2-10 (9 rows) at x=8 and x=16, rows 2-11 at x=23, under a 1-row brown back edge
evidence: The column scan at x=16 shows a light top band (L=151, rows 2-10), then an abrupt drop to dark rows 11-13 (L=28), then a brown front face (L=65) down to row 40. The top band is several rows tall and much lighter than the front, so it reads as a horizontal surface. The dark scalloped band under it works as an overhang shadow. There is no distinct 1-row front-edge line, and the front details are scattered dark and magenta marks rather than clearly inset openings. The top surface and front face are both present, so it passes, though not cleanly.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 5 distinct colours and a median of 5 colours per tile, against 38-40 distinct colours and 17-20 per tile in the references. 51% of its pixels sit in 5x5 flat blocks, against 0-13% in the references. Both the green top and the brown front are nearly flat single tones with no grain or per-material ramp. 100% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, which gives the sticker-like outline, while the references' outlines are tinted (1% and 33% neutral). It is much shallower than the references.
